wire.name: Laplace-Unicode-Atom-Record-v2

payload_wire_grammars.canonical-ascii-property-value: one-or-more ASCII letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen; no terminator
payload_wire_grammars.optional-u32le-position-and-canonical-as: zero bytes, or u32le position followed by one ASCII letter
payload_wire_grammars.optional-u32le-position: zero bytes, or one u32le position
payload_wire_grammars.u32le-position-sequence: zero or more contiguous u32le positions
payload_wire_grammars.tagged-u32le-position-sequence: zero bytes, or u16le tag_bytes + u16le zero + u32le position_count + canonical ASCII tag + position_count u32le positions
payload_wire_grammars.canonical-ascii-rational-or-empty: zero bytes, or canonical signed integer optionally followed by slash and a nonzero canonical unsigned denominator; leading zeroes are forbidden
payload_wire_grammars.sorted-tagged-u32le-positions: zero bytes, or u32le count followed by strictly tag-ascending fixed entries of u8 tag + three zero bytes + u32le position; tags 1,2,3 mean lower,title,upper
payload_wire_grammars.sorted-lower-title-upper-position-sequen: zero bytes, or u32le entry_count followed by strictly byte-lexicographic entries; each entry is u16le condition_count + u16le zero + three u32le mapping counts + lower/title/upper u32le position sequences + strictly byte-lexicographic u16le-length-prefixed canonical ASCII conditions
payload_wire_grammars.sorted-status-and-u32le-position-sequenc: zero bytes, or u32le count followed by strictly status-ascending entries of ASCII status C/F/S/T + three zero bytes + u32le position_count + positions
payload_wire_grammars.sorted-canonical-ascii-set: zero bytes, or u32le count followed by strictly byte-lexicographic u16le-length-prefixed canonical ASCII values
payload_wire_grammars.sorted-canonical-ascii-key-value-set: zero bytes, or u32le count followed by strictly key-ascending u16le key_bytes + u16le value_bytes + canonical ASCII key + canonical ASCII value entries
payload_wire_grammars.u8-boolean: exactly one byte equal to zero or one
payload_wire_grammars.sorted-typed-normalization-property-set: zero bytes, or u32le count followed by strictly key-ascending entries of u16le key_bytes + u8 value_kind + u8 zero + u32le value_count + canonical ASCII property key + typed value; value kinds 1,2,3,4 mean binary true, canonical ASCII property value, u32le position sequence, explicit empty position sequence; kinds 1 and 4 require zero count and no value bytes; kind 2 counts ASCII bytes; kind 3 counts positions

wire.empty_payload_rule: only payload kinds explicitly permitting zero bytes use empty as the canonical absent-or-default representation; counted containers must be nonempty when present

source_value_canonicalization.property_authority: ucd/PropertyAliases.txt from the same retained and verified source bundle
source_value_canonicalization.property_value_authority: ucd/PropertyValueAliases.txt from the same retained and verified source bundle
source_value_canonicalization.comparison: UAX44 loose matching over ASCII property aliases
source_value_canonicalization.property_emission: the formal long property alias in the second semicolon field
source_value_canonicalization.property_value_emission: the long property-value alias in the third semicolon field
rules: aliases are resolved within their property namespace because value aliases are not globally unique
UnicodeData First and Last ranges are validated as one exact value interval before expansion
DerivedBidiClass ordered missing rules are applied before explicit ranges
unknown ambiguous or conflicting aliases reject the root build

derived_default_semantics.full_case_mappings: an absent field-10 payload means use the UnicodeData simple mapping when present and otherwise map the position to itself; encoded SpecialCasing entries preserve explicit empty mappings and sorted locale/context conditions
derived_default_semantics.case_folding: an absent field-11 payload means identity; every explicit C/F/S/T status row is retained and sorted by status

normalization_properties.emission: only explicit DerivedNormalizationProps memberships are encoded; property keys use formal long aliases

derived_default_semantics.script_extensions: an uncovered position emits the effective Script value as a singleton set
derived_default_semantics.composition_exclusion: field-19 is the derived Full_Composition_Exclusion property used by normalization composition; raw CompositionExclusions is retained as an independently checked proper subset witness
